Inside Sales – Time4Learning & Brightspire Virtual School
The Sales Development Representative & Enrollment Specialist serves as the first, most trusted connection for families exploring Time4Learning homeschool curriculum and Brightspire Virtual School for grades 6–12. This role blends consultative sales, customer support, and enrollment guidance to help families choose the right learning pathway — whether that’s purchasing Time4Learning’s PreK–12 curriculum or completing Brightspire’s accredited school application process.
You will identify, qualify, and convert leads; guide families through curriculum selection or school enrollment; and ensure every parent feels confident, supported, and ready to move forward. This is an individual contributor role with clear ownership of lead conversion and enrollment success.

Time4Learning, a Cambium® Learning Group brand, offers award‑winning online curriculum, resources, and programs for at‑home learning. Our ecosystem includes:
Time4Learning — PreK–12 online homeschool curriculum
Homeschool.com Marketplace — trusted hub for home education resources
Brightspire Virtual School — accredited online school for grades 6–12
We are a remote‑first team committed to helping families thrive in flexible, non‑traditional learning environments.

Sales & Lead Conversion
Respond to all inbound inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social channels with speed, clarity, and empathy.
Conduct targeted outreach to families exploring homeschool, independent study, or virtual school options.
Qualify prospects and convert interest into Time4Learning curriculum purchases or Brightspire enrollment applications.
Manage consultation appointments and deliver high‑quality sessions that build trust and confidence.
Use solution‑oriented sales techniques to create an impeccable first impression.
Brightspire Enrollment Support
Guide families through the full application process — registration, payment, document submission, transcript review, and credit transfer.
Answer questions about placement, graduation pathways, and school policies.
Provide enrollment status updates and ensure families understand next steps.
Coordinate post‑enrollment data and identify families who may need additional support.
Engage school staff to ensure smooth onboarding and student success.
Time4Learning Curriculum Sales
Guide families through the process of moving to homeschool and choosing a curriculum — From following guidelines by state to setting up their parent planner.
Answer questions about courses, time spent homeschooling and parent support needed.
Upsell families to curriculum plans that include Annual membership, books, spiritwear and more.
Customer Experience & CRM
Document all interactions accurately in Salesforce or similar CRM.
Identify patterns and recommend improvements to increase enrollment and customer satisfaction.
Resolve concerns quickly with professionalism, empathy, and follow‑through.
Maintain a positive, supportive attitude with families and internal teams.
Execute special projects as assigned.

2–4 years inside sales or call‑center experience, ideally in education, edtech, or SaaS.
High school diploma or equivalent (GED) required.
Proven ability to close deals while building long‑term customer relationships.

👉 In unserem Unternehmen schätzen wir Vielfalt und fördern sie aktiv – wir sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe uns stärker machen. Wir legen den Fokus auf Potenzial statt auf einen „perfekten“ Lebenslauf.

Wenn dich diese Rolle begeistert und du glaubst, dass du in ihr wachsen kannst – auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst – freuen wir uns sehr, von dir zu hören! Darauf kannst du dich bei Shopfully freuen 🤗 🌎 Eine spannende Möglichkeit, in einem internationalen, schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitzuwirken 🕶️ Ein offenes, lebendiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld 🧠 Viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells 📚 Kontinuierliche Entwicklung durch Lernangebote und regelmäßiges Feedback 🍓 Ein modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro mit frischen Snacks, Kaffee und ergonomischer Ausstattung 🎉 Gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die verbinden: Offsites, After-Work-Drinks, Firmenfeiern und Teamevents 💻 Die passende Ausstattung, damit du überall produktiv arbeiten und dir deinen Arbeitsplatz optimal einrichten kannst 🧰 Zusätzliche standortspezifische Benefits entsprechend deinem lokalen Vertrag (Empfehlungsprogramm, Shopping-Rabatte etc.) WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities.

We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ I N SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯
Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
Learn Loudly : We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
Challenge with Empathy : We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust. Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. It keeps the quality honest and it means the work you do actually matters downstream. If you're ready to trade volume for something with more substance, it's worth a conversation.
🎯 What you’ll own
Your accounts are mid-market and enterprise (150-5,000 employees). You run the full qualification process before anything reaches an AE, which in practice looks like this:
Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

You've done B2B outbound before and you have a real opinion on what makes a qualification call worth something. That's the baseline.
1-2 years of outbound sales or SDR experience in B2B
You've worked accounts with no clean data, navigated gatekeepers, and made multi-touch sequences actually work
You think about pipeline quality, not just volume, and you can explain the difference to someone who disagrees
Fluent German, working English
You manage your own day well and take feedback seriously when it comes
🤩 What's different here
The qualification bar here is genuinely high. A meeting without a clear pain chain doesn't move forward, and you're expected to know that before it reaches the AE. There's no hiding behind dial counts or activity metrics when the pipeline tells a different story.
The accounts you'll work aren't easy. No clean contact data, gatekeepers who've heard every opener, prospects who need a few different approaches before they pick up. The job isn't to call more. It's to find the angle that works, and to keep looking until you do.
When it clicks, you feel it. Your pipeline moves, your meetings convert, and the AE comes back wanting more. People here have moved to AE in around 24 months. That track is real, and it starts with the quality of what you build in this role.
🚀 Why doinstruct
You'll get coaching from Jiri (one of Germany's top sales trainers) alongside day-to-day feedback from an SDR lead who's genuinely among the best in the country
The SDR team has real influence on how we approach markets. You're not just running someone else's sequences
We're honest about what's working and what isn't, in both directions
400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which makes the conversation easier

About Peec AI
Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.
We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build Peec AI's outbound engine from the ground up. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying and engaging high-potential prospects, generating qualified pipeline, and partnering closely with Sales and Marketing to sharpen our go-to-market approach.

This role means real ownership, room to shape how we do outbound, and a clear path to grow into a closing role as we scale.

If you're the kind of person who gets a rush from picking up the phone, loves the puzzle of finding the right person to call, and wants to sell a product that's genuinely at the frontier of where search is heading, this is the role for you.

Drive outbound prospecting by identifying and engaging decision-makers across SEO, marketing, and growth functions at companies that would benefit from Peec AI in the French speaking market
Execute personalized, high-quality outreach with cold calling at the core and email and LinkedIn in support, to generate qualified meetings and build pipeline for the Account Executive team
Leverage AI-powered tools to research prospects, personalize messaging at scale, and continuously sharpen your outbound approach
Collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to refine targeting, messaging, and positioning based on what's resonating in the market
Contribute to the development of outbound playbooks and prospecting approaches as the SDR function scales

Hungry, driven, and relentlessly motivated, with a habit of setting ambitious targets and not stopping until you hit them
A natural on the phone who genuinely enjoys cold calling and sees every dial as an opportunity, not a chore
Passionate about technology and the role AI is playing in reshaping how businesses operate and grow, ideally someone who already uses AI tools as part of their day-to-day workflow
Highly coachable and open to feedback, treating every conversation as a data point
Excited about the opportunity to learn the full sales cycle and grow toward an Account Executive role over time

Experience with outbound sales tools such as Clay, Lemlist, Apollo, or similar
Familiarity with the SEO, content marketing, or digital analytics space
Prior experience in a B2B SaaS environment, even in a junior or internship capacity
A track record of hitting or exceeding activity and meeting targets in a previous SDR or similar role
Experience as an SDR/BDR operating in French territories

Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

# Mitarbeiter Verkaufssupport (w/m/d) Generalagentur Liestal #
**Versicherung Generalagentur / Liestal** **/ Berufserfahrene** **/ Unbefristet/ 100%**
## Das erwartet dich ##
In dieser vielseitigen Rolle bist du nahe am Verkauf, nahe an unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und ein wichtiger Dreh- und Angelpunkt im täglichen Geschäft. Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden aktiv und trägst mit deinem Engagement dazu bei, dass Kundenanliegen rasch verstanden und überzeugend gelöst werden.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du bist mittendrin im Verkaufsgeschehen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden optimal unterstützt werden.
Mit deinem Organisationstalent erstellst du Offerten, verarbeitest Anträge und koordinierst Termine über alle Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein verkäuferisches Flair aktiv ein: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, denkst mit und trägst dazu bei, dass aus Kontakten überzeugende Lösungen entstehen.
Ob am Telefon, am Empfang auf der Generalagentur oder im Austausch mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen: Du begegnest Menschen offen, dienstleistungsorientiert und mit Freude. So leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zu einem professionellen Kundenerlebnis und zum gemeinsamen Verkaufserfolg unserer Generalagentur.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ergänzt durch den Versicherungsvermittler VBV oder den Versicherungsfachmann/-frau mit eidg. Fachausweis
* Fundierte Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche und kennstisse über Bedürfnisse von Kundinnen, Kunden und Vertriebspartnern

s.h: Who will work well with us
s.t:
The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate and interested in the arts/larger creative arena or is eager to learn.
We welcome all individuals entering the workforce, those moving into a new stage of their career or vocation, making a change, returning to work, and those wanting to learn and grow within the industry, to apply.
About the Opportunity
Sales Assistant to Senior Partner
David Zwirner seeks a full-time Sales Assistant to work alongside one of the gallery's Senior Partners. The Sales Assistant will fulfill administrative assistant duties as well as liaise with curators, artists, and clients for the Senior Partner.
Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required. This position will involve significant contact with artists and long time clients and other art industry professionals therefore discretion and poise are essential. This position may be scheduled Mondays - Fridays or Tuesdays - Saturdays depending on gallery needs.
Candidates must be diligent, extremely organized, and possess excellent time management and communication skills.

s.h: Support Senior Partner with roster of artists
s.t:
Assist with general artist management of artists’ studios and estates, with exhibitions, requests, press, image requests, general studio requests, events, appraisals and artist care.
Monitor all artists’ solo/group exhibitions, both domestic and international, manage checklists and loans.
Support with gallery exhibition planning globally.
Liaise with other gallery staff regarding all aspects of inventory & exhibition management: production, shipping, framing, photography, research, etc.
Create and manage client lists for exhibition previews/dinners, support Director during openings.

s.h: Provide broad sales support to Senior Partner
s.t:
Manage Senior Partner's sales, help create sales offers, coordinate and prepare for client viewings and prepare insurance appraisals.
Conduct post-sale tasks including preparing invoices and coordinating shipping.
Manage the Senior Partner's secondary market consignments, prepare consignment and contract agreements; liaise with clients on cataloging and research materials, and create presentations for client offers and significant works.
Work across departments to ensure secondary market artworks have photography, provenance and all other relevant documentation.

Daily management of Senior Partner’s calendar, agendas, to-do list and help set daily priorities and goals. Prepare travel arrangements, itineraries, appointments and expenses.
Responsible for organising the Senior Partner's inbox, and staying on top of all communication requests.
Liaise frequently with multiple departments within the gallery to oversee projects such as exhibition and art fair booth models, gallery exhibition checklists, online viewing rooms, sales previews, and press packets, among others.

s.h: What we would like you to have
s.t:
2-3 years in an assistant or administrative support role at a gallery.
Experience supporting senior leadership with calendar management and travel itinerary.
Detail oriented with experience in managing upwards.
Strong multi-tasking skills with the ability to prioritize and anticipate needs as well as organisational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work cross-departmentally.
Strong interest in sales.
Passion for and knowledge of contemporary art.

s.h: What you will love about David Zwirner

The Strategic Business Development Advisor is responsible for developing and executing territory and account engagement strategies that expand Galvanize's presence within Enterprise and Government markets.

This role exercises independent judgment in identifying market opportunities, prioritizing target accounts, developing prospect engagement strategies, qualifying business opportunities, and advising internal stakeholders on market trends, customer needs, and pipeline development.

The position collaborates closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Strategic Account Advisors to optimize business development initiatives and improve sales effectiveness.

Strategic Pipeline Development
Develop and execute territory-specific prospecting and account engagement strategies aligned with organizational revenue objectives.
Analyze target markets, industry trends, customer initiatives, competitive activity, and organizational priorities to identify high-value business opportunities.
Determine outreach priorities and engagement approaches based on independent assessment of account potential, buying readiness, and strategic fit.
Design and adapt multi-channel engagement strategies utilizing email, phone, LinkedIn, referrals, events, and other approved business development channels.
Evaluate campaign effectiveness and modify outreach strategies to improve engagement and conversion rates.
Business Opportunity Assessment
Conduct consultative discovery conversations to evaluate organizational priorities, workforce challenges, AI initiatives, budget considerations, and strategic objectives.
Exercise independent judgment in determining opportunity qualification, sales readiness, stakeholder alignment, and appropriate next steps.
Identify business risks, obstacles, and competitive considerations while recommending strategies to advance opportunities.
Develop account intelligence and strategic recommendations that enable successful engagement by Strategic Account Advisors.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Serve as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership by providing market intelligence, customer feedback, and recommendations for improving business development effectiveness.
Collaborate with Marketing to refine messaging, campaign strategy, and target audience segmentation.
Recommend improvements to business development processes, sales workflows, qualification methodology, and CRM utilization.
Participate in planning discussions regarding territory development, market expansion, and pipeline forecasting.
Pipeline Management & Business Analysis
Maintain responsibility for the quality, health, and strategic direction of assigned business development pipeline.
Analyze pipeline performance, conversion metrics, and engagement effectiveness to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare reports and communicate market observations, business risks, opportunity forecasts, and pipeline insights to leadership.
Ensure CRM records accurately reflect strategic account information, customer needs, opportunity status, and recommended actions.

3+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, consultative sales, recruiting, or a related client-facing business role.
Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize work, manage territory strategy, and exercise sound business judgment.
Experience analyzing customer organizations and developing strategic engagement plans.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to executive and senior leadership audiences.
Experience using CRM systems, sales engagement platforms, and business productivity software.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities and competing business objectives.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Experience developing Enterprise or Government accounts.
Knowledge of public-sector procurement, workforce development, professional services, or technology solutions.
Understanding of AI adoption, workforce transformation, and organizational change initiatives.
Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success functions.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Pour l-un de nos clients, une entreprise leader dans le secteur des Sciences de la Vie, nous recherchons actuellement un **Spécialiste Technique des Ventes - Génomique / qPCR** pour renforcer son équipe commerciale en Suisse.
Ce poste est idéal pour un candidat ayant un **solide bagage scientifique** qui souhaite allier expertise technique, interaction client et développement commercial. Vous travaillerez avec une large gamme de clients à travers la Suisse, incluant des instituts de recherche, des laboratoires, des organisations de santé et des entreprises des Sciences de la Vie.
**Spécialiste Technique des Ventes - Sciences de la Vie**
## Vos Responsabilités ##
En tant que Spécialiste Technique des Ventes Génomique / qPCR, vous serez responsable du développement et de la gestion des relations clients tout en apportant une expertise scientifique et technique sur les solutions de l-entreprise.

* Développer les activités commerciales et identifier de nouvelles opportunités d-affaires sur le marché suisse.
* Gérer le cycle complet de vente, du premier contact client et de l-évaluation des besoins jusqu-aux présentations, démonstrations, devis et clôture.
* Comprendre les exigences scientifiques et techniques des clients et les traduire en solutions appropriées.
* Développer et maintenir des relations solides avec les clients existants tout en identifiant des opportunités commerciales supplémentaires.
* Fournir un support technique et scientifique lors des échanges avec les clients.
* Organiser et participer aux réunions clients, ateliers, démonstrations de produits et sessions de formation.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes de vente, spécialistes applications et produits.
* Maintenir des informations précises concernant les clients, opportunités et activités commerciales dans le CRM.
* Surveiller les évolutions du marché, les concurrents et les besoins émergents des clients.
* Participer aux séminaires, expositions, congrès et autres événements du secteur selon les besoins.
## Votre Profil ##
* **Solide formation scientifique en Sciences de la Vie** ; un Master ou une qualification scientifique équivalente est préféré.
* Plusieurs années d-expérience en laboratoire ou technique dans le domaine des Sciences de la Vie.
* **Très bonne connaissance des technologies PCR**, idéalement incluant **qPCR et/ou ddPCR**.
* Bonne connaissance et compréhension de **l-immunologie / immunohématologie** et des technologies de laboratoire associées.
* Au moins une **première expérience en vente, vente technique ou poste commercial en contact avec la clientèle** dans les Sciences de la Vie.
* Capacité à comprendre des applications scientifiques complexes et à en discuter avec assurance avec des clients techniques.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, présentation et développement de relations.
* Esprit commercial avec la capacité d-identifier et de développer des opportunités d-affaires.
* **La maîtrise courante de l-allemand et de l-anglais est obligatoire.**
* **Le français est fortement souhaité** et sera considéré comme un atout majeur.
* À l-aise pour travailler de manière autonome en environnement distant et pour se déplacer chez les clients si nécessaire.
* Permis de conduire valide.
## L-Opportunité ##
Il s-agit d-un **poste permanent offrant un travail 100 % à distance**, avec la possibilité de combiner **science, technologie et ventes** dans un environnement très spécialisé des Sciences de la Vie.
Vous bénéficierez d-une grande autonomie dans votre rôle tout en restant étroitement connecté à une équipe pluridisciplinaire et aux clients à travers la Suisse.
